title: A familiar health plan
hook: Two stated cases: explore the stated weight on a current option.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the stated weight on a current option affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Final, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the stated weight on a current option in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy population keeps default contribution 1 with probability 0.8; otherwise chooses 0. What is the mean contribution?
